title: Cambridge IELTS 17 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The maps below show an industrial area in the town of Norbiton, and planned future development of the site.
scenario: The maps compare the current Norbiton industrial area with its planned future development.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.type: Two maps showing the current industrial area and its planned future development
visualData.title: Norbiton industrial area now; Planned future development
notes: In the current map, a main road runs east–west along the southern edge. A road leads north from it to a central roundabout, and another road extends east from the roundabout.
Eight factories are shown around the central roundabout and along the road extending east.
The river runs across the northern part of the site, with farmland beyond it. The town lies to the west.
In the planned development, the factories are replaced by housing and community facilities.
A second roundabout is added on the main road south of the existing roundabout.
A road extends north from the existing roundabout, crosses the river and ends in a loop, with housing beyond the river.
Additional roads extend northwest and southwest from the existing roundabout.
Shops and a medical centre are planned southwest of the existing roundabout.
A playground and school are planned east of the existing roundabout.
Housing is shown northwest of the existing roundabout, beside the northward road, beyond the river, and along the roads east of the roundabout.
The legends are ‘= Factory’ for the current map and ‘= Housing’ for the planned map.
